scene.label: Act 5, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. A room in Lucentio's house.

content.text: Enter Baptista, Vincentio, Gremio, the Pedant, Lucentio, Bianca, Petruchio, Katherina, Hortensio and Widow. Tranio, Biondello and Grumio and Others, attending.

lines.text: At last, though long, our jarring notes agree:
lines.plainText: At last though long our jarring notes agree

lines.text: And time it is when raging war is done,
lines.plainText: And time it is when raging war is done

lines.text: To smile at 'scapes and perils overblown.
lines.plainText: To smile at 'scapes and perils overblown

lines.text: My fair Bianca, bid my father welcome,
lines.plainText: My fair Bianca bid my father welcome

lines.text: While I with self-same kindness welcome thine.
lines.plainText: While I with selfsame kindness welcome thine

lines.text: Brother Petruchio, sister Katherina,
lines.plainText: Brother Petruchio sister Katherina

lines.text: And thou, Hortensio, with thy loving widow,
lines.plainText: And thou Hortensio with thy loving widow

lines.text: Feast with the best, and welcome to my house:
lines.plainText: Feast with the best and welcome to my house

lines.text: My banquet is to close our stomachs up,
lines.plainText: My banquet is to close our stomachs up

lines.text: After our great good cheer. Pray you, sit down;
lines.plainText: After our great good cheer Pray you sit down

lines.text: For now we sit to chat as well as eat.
lines.plainText: For now we sit to chat as well as eat

lines.text: Nothing but sit and sit, and eat and eat!
lines.plainText: Nothing but sit and sit and eat and eat

lines.text: Padua affords this kindness, son Petruchio.
lines.plainText: Padua affords this kindness son Petruchio

lines.text: Padua affords nothing but what is kind.
lines.plainText: Padua affords nothing but what is kind

lines.text: For both our sakes I would that word were true.
lines.plainText: For both our sakes I would that word were true

lines.text: Now, for my life, Hortensio fears his widow.
lines.plainText: Now for my life Hortensio fears his widow

lines.text: Then never trust me if I be afeard.
lines.plainText: Then never trust me if I be afeard

lines.text: You are very sensible, and yet you miss my sense:
lines.plainText: You are very sensible and yet you miss my sense

lines.text: I mean Hortensio is afeard of you.
lines.plainText: I mean Hortensio is afeard of you

lines.text: He that is giddy thinks the world turns round.
lines.plainText: He that is giddy thinks the world turns round

lines.text: Roundly replied.
lines.plainText: Roundly replied

lines.text: Mistress, how mean you that?
lines.plainText: Mistress how mean you that

lines.text: Thus I conceive by him.
lines.plainText: Thus I conceive by him

lines.text: Conceives by me! How likes Hortensio that?
lines.plainText: Conceives by me How likes Hortensio that

lines.text: My widow says thus she conceives her tale.
lines.plainText: My widow says thus she conceives her tale

lines.text: Very well mended. Kiss him for that, good widow.
lines.plainText: Very well mended Kiss him for that good widow

lines.text: 'He that is giddy thinks the world turns round':
lines.plainText: 'He that is giddy thinks the world turns round'

lines.text: I pray you tell me what you meant by that.
lines.plainText: I pray you tell me what you meant by that

lines.text: Your husband, being troubled with a shrew,
lines.plainText: Your husband being troubled with a shrew

lines.text: Measures my husband's sorrow by his woe;
lines.plainText: Measures my husband's sorrow by his woe

lines.text: And now you know my meaning.
lines.plainText: And now you know my meaning

lines.text: A very mean meaning.
lines.plainText: A very mean meaning

lines.text: Right, I mean you.
lines.plainText: Right I mean you

lines.text: And I am mean, indeed, respecting you.
lines.plainText: And I am mean indeed respecting you

lines.text: To her, Kate!
lines.plainText: To her Kate

lines.text: To her, widow!
lines.plainText: To her widow

lines.text: A hundred marks, my Kate does put her down.
lines.plainText: A hundred marks my Kate does put her down

lines.text: That's my office.
lines.plainText: That's my office

lines.text: Spoke like an officer: ha' to thee, lad.
lines.plainText: Spoke like an officer ha' to thee lad

lines.text: How likes Gremio these quick-witted folks?
lines.plainText: How likes Gremio these quickwitted folks

lines.text: Believe me, sir, they butt together well.
lines.plainText: Believe me sir they butt together well

lines.text: Head and butt! An hasty-witted body
lines.plainText: Head and butt An hastywitted body

lines.text: Would say your head and butt were head and horn.
lines.plainText: Would say your head and butt were head and horn

lines.text: Ay, mistress bride, hath that awaken'd you?
lines.plainText: Ay mistress bride hath that awaken'd you

lines.text: Ay, but not frighted me; therefore I'll sleep again.
lines.plainText: Ay but not frighted me therefore I'll sleep again

lines.text: Nay, that you shall not; since you have begun,
lines.plainText: Nay that you shall not since you have begun

lines.text: Have at you for a bitter jest or two.
lines.plainText: Have at you for a bitter jest or two

lines.text: Am I your bird? I mean to shift my bush,
lines.plainText: Am I your bird I mean to shift my bush

lines.text: And then pursue me as you draw your bow.
lines.plainText: And then pursue me as you draw your bow

lines.text: You are welcome all.
lines.plainText: You are welcome all

lines.text: She hath prevented me. Here, Signior Tranio;
lines.plainText: She hath prevented me Here Signior Tranio

lines.text: This bird you aim'd at, though you hit her not:
lines.plainText: This bird you aim'd at though you hit her not

lines.text: Therefore a health to all that shot and miss'd.
lines.plainText: Therefore a health to all that shot and miss'd

lines.text: O, sir! Lucentio slipp'd me like his greyhound,
lines.plainText: O sir Lucentio slipp'd me like his greyhound

lines.text: Which runs himself, and catches for his master.
lines.plainText: Which runs himself and catches for his master

lines.text: A good swift simile, but something currish.
lines.plainText: A good swift simile but something currish

lines.text: 'Tis well, sir, that you hunted for yourself:
lines.plainText: 'Tis well sir that you hunted for yourself

lines.text: 'Tis thought your deer does hold you at a bay.
lines.plainText: 'Tis thought your deer does hold you at a bay

lines.text: O ho, Petruchio! Tranio hits you now.
lines.plainText: O ho Petruchio Tranio hits you now

lines.text: I thank thee for that gird, good Tranio.
lines.plainText: I thank thee for that gird good Tranio

lines.text: Confess, confess; hath he not hit you here?
lines.plainText: Confess confess hath he not hit you here

lines.text: A has a little gall'd me, I confess;
lines.plainText: A has a little gall'd me I confess

lines.text: And as the jest did glance away from me,
lines.plainText: And as the jest did glance away from me

lines.text: 'Tis ten to one it maim'd you two outright.
lines.plainText: 'Tis ten to one it maim'd you two outright

lines.text: Now, in good sadness, son Petruchio,
lines.plainText: Now in good sadness son Petruchio

lines.text: I think thou hast the veriest shrew of all.
lines.plainText: I think thou hast the veriest shrew of all

lines.text: Well, I say no; and therefore, for assurance,
lines.plainText: Well I say no and therefore for assurance

lines.text: Let's each one send unto his wife,
lines.plainText: Let's each one send unto his wife

lines.text: And he whose wife is most obedient,
lines.plainText: And he whose wife is most obedient

lines.text: To come at first when he doth send for her,
lines.plainText: To come at first when he doth send for her

lines.text: Shall win the wager which we will propose.
lines.plainText: Shall win the wager which we will propose

lines.text: Content. What's the wager?
lines.plainText: Content What's the wager

lines.text: Twenty crowns.
lines.plainText: Twenty crowns

lines.text: Twenty crowns!
lines.plainText: Twenty crowns

lines.text: I'll venture so much of my hawk or hound,
lines.plainText: I'll venture so much of my hawk or hound

lines.text: But twenty times so much upon my wife.
lines.plainText: But twenty times so much upon my wife

lines.text: A hundred then.
lines.plainText: A hundred then

lines.text: Content.
lines.plainText: Content

lines.text: A match! 'tis done.
lines.plainText: A match 'tis done

lines.text: Who shall begin?
lines.plainText: Who shall begin

lines.text: That will I.
lines.plainText: That will I

lines.text: Go, Biondello, bid your mistress come to me.
lines.plainText: Go Biondello bid your mistress come to me

lines.text: I go.
lines.plainText: I go

lines.text: Son, I'll be your half, Bianca comes.
lines.plainText: Son I'll be your half Bianca comes

lines.text: I'll have no halves; I'll bear it all myself.
lines.plainText: I'll have no halves I'll bear it all myself

lines.text: Sir, my mistress sends you word
lines.plainText: Sir my mistress sends you word

lines.text: That she is busy and she cannot come.
lines.plainText: That she is busy and she cannot come

lines.text: How! She's busy, and she cannot come!
lines.plainText: How She's busy and she cannot come

lines.text: Is that an answer?
lines.plainText: Is that an answer

lines.text: Ay, and a kind one too:
lines.plainText: Ay and a kind one too

lines.text: Pray God, sir, your wife send you not a worse.
lines.plainText: Pray God sir your wife send you not a worse

lines.text: I hope better.
lines.plainText: I hope better

lines.text: Sirrah Biondello, go and entreat my wife
lines.plainText: Sirrah Biondello go and entreat my wife

lines.text: To come to me forthwith.
lines.plainText: To come to me forthwith

lines.text: O, ho! entreat her!
lines.plainText: O ho entreat her

lines.text: Nay, then she must needs come.
lines.plainText: Nay then she must needs come

lines.text: I am afraid, sir,
lines.plainText: I am afraid sir

lines.text: Do what you can, yours will not be entreated.
lines.plainText: Do what you can yours will not be entreated

lines.text: She says you have some goodly jest in hand:
lines.plainText: She says you have some goodly jest in hand

lines.text: She will not come; she bids you come to her.
lines.plainText: She will not come she bids you come to her

lines.text: Worse and worse; she will not come! O vile,
lines.plainText: Worse and worse she will not come O vile

lines.text: Intolerable, not to be endur'd!
lines.plainText: Intolerable not to be endur'd

lines.text: Sirrah Grumio, go to your mistress,
lines.plainText: Sirrah Grumio go to your mistress

lines.text: Say I command her come to me.
lines.plainText: Say I command her come to me

lines.text: I know her answer.
lines.plainText: I know her answer

lines.text: What?
lines.plainText: What

lines.text: She will not.
lines.plainText: She will not

lines.text: The fouler fortune mine, and there an end.
lines.plainText: The fouler fortune mine and there an end

lines.text: Now, by my holidame, here comes Katherina!
lines.plainText: Now by my holidame here comes Katherina

lines.text: What is your will sir, that you send for me?
lines.plainText: What is your will sir that you send for me

lines.text: Where is your sister, and Hortensio's wife?
lines.plainText: Where is your sister and Hortensio's wife

lines.text: They sit conferring by the parlour fire.
lines.plainText: They sit conferring by the parlour fire

lines.text: Go fetch them hither; if they deny to come,
lines.plainText: Go fetch them hither if they deny to come

lines.text: Swinge me them soundly forth unto their husbands.
lines.plainText: Swinge me them soundly forth unto their husbands

lines.text: Away, I say, and bring them hither straight.
lines.plainText: Away I say and bring them hither straight

lines.text: Here is a wonder, if you talk of a wonder.
lines.plainText: Here is a wonder if you talk of a wonder

lines.text: And so it is. I wonder what it bodes.
lines.plainText: And so it is I wonder what it bodes

lines.text: Marry, peace it bodes, and love, and quiet life,
lines.plainText: Marry peace it bodes and love and quiet life

lines.text: An awful rule, and right supremacy;
lines.plainText: An awful rule and right supremacy

lines.text: And, to be short, what not that's sweet and happy.
lines.plainText: And to be short what not that's sweet and happy

lines.text: Now fair befall thee, good Petruchio!
lines.plainText: Now fair befall thee good Petruchio

lines.text: The wager thou hast won; and I will add
lines.plainText: The wager thou hast won and I will add

lines.text: Unto their losses twenty thousand crowns;
lines.plainText: Unto their losses twenty thousand crowns

lines.text: Another dowry to another daughter,
lines.plainText: Another dowry to another daughter

lines.text: For she is chang'd, as she had never been.
lines.plainText: For she is chang'd as she had never been

lines.text: Nay, I will win my wager better yet,
lines.plainText: Nay I will win my wager better yet

lines.text: And show more sign of her obedience,
lines.plainText: And show more sign of her obedience

lines.text: Her new-built virtue and obedience.
lines.plainText: Her newbuilt virtue and obedience

lines.text: See where she comes, and brings your froward wives
lines.plainText: See where she comes and brings your froward wives

lines.text: As prisoners to her womanly persuasion.
lines.plainText: As prisoners to her womanly persuasion

content.text: Re-enter Katherina with Bianca and Widow.
[Katherina pulls off her cap and throws it down.]

lines.text: Lord, let me never have a cause to sigh
lines.plainText: Lord let me never have a cause to sigh

lines.text: Till I be brought to such a silly pass!
lines.plainText: Till I be brought to such a silly pass

lines.text: Fie! what a foolish duty call you this?
lines.plainText: Fie what a foolish duty call you this

lines.text: I would your duty were as foolish too;
lines.plainText: I would your duty were as foolish too

lines.text: The wisdom of your duty, fair Bianca,
lines.plainText: The wisdom of your duty fair Bianca

lines.text: Hath cost me a hundred crowns since supper-time!
lines.plainText: Hath cost me a hundred crowns since suppertime

lines.text: The more fool you for laying on my duty.
lines.plainText: The more fool you for laying on my duty

lines.text: Katherine, I charge thee, tell these headstrong women
lines.plainText: Katherine I charge thee tell these headstrong women

lines.text: What duty they do owe their lords and husbands.
lines.plainText: What duty they do owe their lords and husbands

lines.text: Come, come, you're mocking; we will have no telling.
lines.plainText: Come come you're mocking we will have no telling

lines.text: Come on, I say; and first begin with her.
lines.plainText: Come on I say and first begin with her

lines.text: She shall not.
lines.plainText: She shall not

lines.text: I say she shall: and first begin with her.
lines.plainText: I say she shall and first begin with her

lines.text: Fie, fie! unknit that threatening unkind brow,
lines.plainText: Fie fie unknit that threatening unkind brow

lines.text: And dart not scornful glances from those eyes
lines.plainText: And dart not scornful glances from those eyes

lines.text: To wound thy lord, thy king, thy governor:
lines.plainText: To wound thy lord thy king thy governor

lines.text: It blots thy beauty as frosts do bite the meads,
lines.plainText: It blots thy beauty as frosts do bite the meads

lines.text: Confounds thy fame as whirlwinds shake fair buds,
lines.plainText: Confounds thy fame as whirlwinds shake fair buds

lines.text: And in no sense is meet or amiable.
lines.plainText: And in no sense is meet or amiable

lines.text: A woman mov'd is like a fountain troubled,
lines.plainText: A woman mov'd is like a fountain troubled

lines.text: Muddy, ill-seeming, thick, bereft of beauty;
lines.plainText: Muddy illseeming thick bereft of beauty

lines.text: And while it is so, none so dry or thirsty
lines.plainText: And while it is so none so dry or thirsty

lines.text: Will deign to sip or touch one drop of it.
lines.plainText: Will deign to sip or touch one drop of it

lines.text: Thy husband is thy lord, thy life, thy keeper,
lines.plainText: Thy husband is thy lord thy life thy keeper

lines.text: Thy head, thy sovereign; one that cares for thee,
lines.plainText: Thy head thy sovereign one that cares for thee

lines.text: And for thy maintenance commits his body
lines.plainText: And for thy maintenance commits his body

lines.text: To painful labour both by sea and land,
lines.plainText: To painful labour both by sea and land

lines.text: To watch the night in storms, the day in cold,
lines.plainText: To watch the night in storms the day in cold

lines.text: Whilst thou liest warm at home, secure and safe;
lines.plainText: Whilst thou liest warm at home secure and safe

lines.text: And craves no other tribute at thy hands
lines.plainText: And craves no other tribute at thy hands

lines.text: But love, fair looks, and true obedience;
lines.plainText: But love fair looks and true obedience

lines.text: Too little payment for so great a debt.
lines.plainText: Too little payment for so great a debt

lines.text: Such duty as the subject owes the prince,
lines.plainText: Such duty as the subject owes the prince

lines.text: Even such a woman oweth to her husband;
lines.plainText: Even such a woman oweth to her husband

lines.text: And when she is froward, peevish, sullen, sour,
lines.plainText: And when she is froward peevish sullen sour

lines.text: And not obedient to his honest will,
lines.plainText: And not obedient to his honest will

lines.text: What is she but a foul contending rebel
lines.plainText: What is she but a foul contending rebel

lines.text: And graceless traitor to her loving lord?—
lines.plainText: And graceless traitor to her loving lord

lines.text: I am asham'd that women are so simple
lines.plainText: I am asham'd that women are so simple

lines.text: To offer war where they should kneel for peace,
lines.plainText: To offer war where they should kneel for peace

lines.text: Or seek for rule, supremacy, and sway,
lines.plainText: Or seek for rule supremacy and sway

lines.text: When they are bound to serve, love, and obey.
lines.plainText: When they are bound to serve love and obey

lines.text: Why are our bodies soft and weak and smooth,
lines.plainText: Why are our bodies soft and weak and smooth

lines.text: Unapt to toil and trouble in the world,
lines.plainText: Unapt to toil and trouble in the world

lines.text: But that our soft conditions and our hearts
lines.plainText: But that our soft conditions and our hearts

lines.text: Should well agree with our external parts?
lines.plainText: Should well agree with our external parts

lines.text: Come, come, you froward and unable worms!
lines.plainText: Come come you froward and unable worms

lines.text: My mind hath been as big as one of yours,
lines.plainText: My mind hath been as big as one of yours

lines.text: My heart as great, my reason haply more,
lines.plainText: My heart as great my reason haply more

lines.text: To bandy word for word and frown for frown;
lines.plainText: To bandy word for word and frown for frown

lines.text: But now I see our lances are but straws,
lines.plainText: But now I see our lances are but straws

lines.text: Our strength as weak, our weakness past compare,
lines.plainText: Our strength as weak our weakness past compare

lines.text: That seeming to be most which we indeed least are.
lines.plainText: That seeming to be most which we indeed least are

lines.text: Then vail your stomachs, for it is no boot,
lines.plainText: Then vail your stomachs for it is no boot

lines.text: And place your hands below your husband's foot:
lines.plainText: And place your hands below your husband's foot

lines.text: In token of which duty, if he please,
lines.plainText: In token of which duty if he please

lines.text: My hand is ready; may it do him ease.
lines.plainText: My hand is ready may it do him ease

lines.text: Why, there's a wench! Come on, and kiss me, Kate.
lines.plainText: Why there's a wench Come on and kiss me Kate

lines.text: Well, go thy ways, old lad, for thou shalt ha't.
lines.plainText: Well go thy ways old lad for thou shalt ha't

lines.plainText: 'Tis a good hearing when children are toward

lines.plainText: But a harsh hearing when women are froward

lines.plainText: Come Kate we'll to bed

lines.plainText: We three are married but you two are sped

lines.text: 'Twas I won the wager,
lines.plainText: 'Twas I won the wager

lines.text: [To Lucentio.] though you hit the white;
lines.plainText: To Lucentio though you hit the white

lines.plainText: And being a winner God give you good night

lines.plainText: Now go thy ways thou hast tam'd a curst shrew
